description: Upscales a low-resolution or blurry video up to 4K (FlashVSR).

duration.description: Duration of the source video in seconds. node.py reads `video.get_duration()` off the IO.Video.Input runtime object; criteria §1.1 makes this a required wrapper-only field at L2 (L3 probes the source and supplies the value). middleware.go:23-26 rejects `duration <= 0` with the same message.

dispatch_mode.description: Dispatch mode. "sync" (default) blocks until the job completes. "async" submits the job and returns immediately with a job ID; poll completion via `job_get`. Named `dispatch_mode` (not bare `mode`) so it never collides with provider-specific `mode` knobs (freepik DynamicCombo, pixverse motion mode, meshy pose mode, …).

target_resolution.description: Target resolution to upscale to. node.py declares the widget without `default=` (criteria doc §2.1: no synthesized L2 default).
